headline: Best combat Pals in Palworld 1.0
title: Best Combat Pals in Palworld | Strongest Fighters for Bosses and Raids | Palworld Guide
video_script: Who are the strongest fighters in Palworld one point zero? At the very top, guides rank Frostallion, Blazamut Ryu and Jormuntide Ignis. For raid bosses, the raid Pals like Bellanoir Libero and Selyne deal the most damage. Jetragon is still the safest all round pick. And here's a tip: Jormuntide Ignis is the strongest non legendary attacker, and it's much easier to breed than the raid Pals. Who carries your team? Comment below!
